name: gogcli-mcp-contacts
description: Extended Google Contacts for Claude via gogcli — auth + Contacts + Workspace directory (People API)

gog_account.title: Google Account
gog_account.description: Default Google account email (optional — uses gogcli's configured default if omitted)

gog_path.title: gog Executable Path
gog_path.description: Path to the gog executable (optional — defaults to 'gog' on your PATH)

gog_file_roots.title: Allowed file directories
gog_file_roots.description: Directories tools may read files from (attachments, uploads) or write files to (exports, downloads), separated by ':' (';' on Windows). Optional — defaults to ~/gogcli-mcp-files

display_tz.title: Display time zone
display_tz.description: zone for *Display fields and for interpreting naive gog values; defaults to America/New_York

gog_readonly.title: Read-only mode
gog_readonly.description: block all mutating gog API requests (injects gog's --readonly); set to 0/false/no/off (or unset) to allow writes

gog_timezone.title: gog time zone
gog_timezone.description: zone gog formats naive dates in; unset, runner.ts hands gog DISPLAY_TZ so the two cannot diverge

tools.name: gog_auth_add
tools.description: Authorize a Google account via browser-based OAuth

tools.name: gog_auth_health
tools.description: Live per-account token health: validity, age, and pre-expiry warnings (detects invalid_grant)

tools.name: gog_auth_add_url
tools.description: Begin remote/headless OAuth (step 1): return a sign-in URL to open in any browser

tools.name: gog_auth_add_complete
tools.description: Complete remote/headless OAuth (step 2): exchange the pasted redirect URL and store the token

tools.name: gog_auth_list
tools.description: List all Google accounts stored in gogcli

tools.name: gog_auth_status
tools.description: Show gogcli auth configuration

tools.name: gog_auth_services
tools.description: List Google services and OAuth scopes supported by gogcli

tools.name: gog_auth_run
tools.description: Run any gog auth subcommand (escape hatch)

tools.name: gog_contacts_search
tools.description: Search personal contacts by name, email, or phone

tools.name: gog_contacts_list
tools.description: List all personal contacts

tools.name: gog_contacts_get
tools.description: Get a contact by resource name

tools.name: gog_contacts_create
tools.description: Create a new contact

tools.name: gog_contacts_run
tools.description: Run any gog contacts subcommand (escape hatch)

tools.name: gog_people_me
tools.description: Show your own People profile

tools.name: gog_people_get
tools.description: Get a People profile by resource name

tools.name: gog_people_search
tools.description: Search the Workspace directory

tools.name: gog_people_relations
tools.description: Get manager/reports relations for a user

tools.name: gog_people_raw
tools.description: Dump raw People API JSON for a person

tools.name: gog_contacts_update
tools.description: Update an existing contact (empty string clears a field)

tools.name: gog_contacts_delete
tools.description: Delete a contact by resource name

tools.name: gog_contacts_export
tools.description: Export contacts as vCard (.vcf)

tools.name: gog_contacts_dedupe
tools.description: Find duplicate contacts; optionally merge and delete redundants

tools.name: gog_contacts_directory_list
tools.description: List people from the Workspace directory

tools.name: gog_contacts_other_list
tools.description: List auto-collected other contacts

tools.name: gog_contacts_other_search
tools.description: Search auto-collected other contacts

tools.name: gog_contacts_batch_get
tools.description: Fetch exact Contacts in native People API batches.

tools.name: gog_contacts_batch_create
tools.description: Create Contacts in native People API batches.

tools.name: gog_contacts_batch_update
tools.description: Update Contacts in native People API batches with etag guards.

tools.name: gog_contacts_batch_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete Contacts in native People API batches after confirmation.
